violation_type.title: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Never Allow Toddlers to Sleep or Walk With Bottles and Training Cups (26 TAC §746.2505(4)(C))

violation_type.typical_finding: A 18 month old was observed sleeping with a training cup inside the crib.    Note: A photo was taken.
